name: What preparation is required before installing a new bathroom vanity top?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is required before installing a new bathroom vanity top?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking your installation, select your sink and faucet models and verify your current plumbing setup. Sinks come in undermount, drop-in, and vessel configurations, each requiring distinct cutout measurements and faucet clearance heights. Measure your vanity base, check whether your water shutoff valves function properly, and decide whether you want an integrated 4-inch stone backsplash or a custom tile wall. Having these plumbing fixtures on site before countertop templating prevents misaligned drill holes and avoids installation delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose and purchase your sink and faucet fixtures in advance, ensure water shutoffs work, and confirm your cabinet dimensions so templating matches your hardware perfectly.
